requirements.shall: Implement opcodes 0..8 and reject reserved opcodes.
Enforce FFT formats 0..2 and RES16 format3 for NTT family.
W128 is bit-exact to pinned scalar LP64 R8 numeric contract.
Do not lower precision automatically; W32/64 have only their explicit integer contract.
Enforce the N/profile support table including incomplete q3329 N256.
Enforce jobs limits; FFT jobs1 and NTT N8/16/32 limits8/4/2.
All jobs in a batch share op,fmt,profile,N and direction.
Keep every batched polynomial and job identity independent.
Host owns load/read only in the states defined by protocol; no host requests in RUN.
Issue/address/root/control schedules are independent of coefficient values for identical control state, address footprint and flow trace.
Do not depend on unwritten RAM; reset does not implicitly initialize or zeroize data.
Use W32/64/128 with fractional bits W/2.
Add/sub wrap modulo2^W without saturation.
Multiply with full mathematical product, bias2^(F-1), shiftF, then wrapW.
div2e wraps bias addition before arithmetic shift; shift0 is identity.
Use exact 3M with wrapped pre-add and independent per-real-product rounding.
Lower limbs are unsigned; only each operand top limb is signed; preserve raw product sign.
Preserve retained W+F product bits, required carries and one final rounding; discard only exact zero-weight terms.
Use pinned exact FFT ROM bits, no sin/cos regeneration.
Conjugate in128 before low-width quantization; form root sum after quantization.
Require canonical NTT coefficients/roots/results; no lazy/signed residue contract.
Montgomery implements full unsigned T, m, carry and canonical conditional subtraction.
Do not apply FFT product truncation to Montgomery T.
Implement CT and GS component/domain equations exactly.
Root tables encode ordinary root times R; inverse ordinary roots before encoding.
FFT uses exact split-real/imag indexing, roots and wrapped arithmetic of section01.4.
IFFT uses inverse roots and final div2e(logn-1), including N1/N2 identity.
CMUL is pointwise complex3M, writes A and preserves B/C.
SPLIT preserves input stores and writes concatenated f0/f1 to C including N2 case.
MERGE reads half-length A/B and writes interleaved component C including N2 case.
NTT uses prescribed CT loop/root/output order and q3329 incomplete stop.
INTT uses prescribed inverse GS loop and final inverse2^L normalization.
TOMONT returns xR modq.
MODMUL returns abR^-1 modq; no implicit ordinary multiply or BASEMUL.
Paired/tail/scalar NTT tile modes preserve coefficient order, roots and job schedule.
Transfer only on sampled rising edge valid&&ready.
Hold valid and complete payload until handshake except reset/canceled internal epoch.
Avoid combinational valid/ready loops.
Latch every CMD field on acceptance; later input changes have no effect.
Allow one outstanding CMD; host memory wins simultaneous IDLE arbitration.
Return exactly one tagged completion per accepted command except reset.
Publish OK only after all writes commit and command pipeline/context drain.
Published completion is immutable through pause/flush until ACK; reset may cancel.
Internal packets retain sufficient epoch/context/lane/phase identity to retire correctly.
Use defined packet packing; zero reserved/inactive bits and preserve active lane masks.
Synchronous active-low reset clears all control valids/state and suppresses writes/replies; hold >=2edges.
Reset preserves data/ROM content; do not rely on initial for control reset.
Validate command fields in specified error priority, without evaluating dependent invalid fields.
Invalid CMD returns error/tag/mask0 without arithmetic/data/root issue or RAM change.
Detected internal invariant failure stops command side effects, drains and returns INTERNAL_FAULT unless reset/flush takes priority.
Validate host store/alignment/range/state using specified priority.
Implement byte-enable writes and little-endian raw128 lines; zero-strobe write is ACKed no-op.
One outstanding host request, exactly one stable ordered response.
ACK host write OK only after enabled bytes have committed.
Enforce IDLE/RUN/DONE/FLUSH memory ownership and DONE write STATE behavior.
Block new command until completion ACK and any earlier memory response drains.
Apply fixed bijective bank/row mapping and <=1R+1W per bank per edge.
Bank read adapter latency is >=1 edge and held response cannot be overwritten.
Serialize overlapping read/write; never depend on macro read-during-write behavior.
Map FFT components to consecutive little-endian limbs16 and preserve split-real/imag layout.
Map NTT job j coefficient i at word j*N+i, same map in B for MODMUL.
Only bytes in output footprint may change; preserve all other bytes/stores.
Pause holds datapath/issue/context/command writes while published external responses may ACK.
Reset/flush override pause and can drain/cancel without pause deadlock.
Implement four-phase level flush handshake and block new requests through release.
Suppress command writes from first sampled flush edge, drain/invalidate all canceled packets.
Unpublished command gets exactly one ABORTED mask0; no rollback, all batch outputs invalid.
Preserve published completion unchanged and do not wait for cpl_ready to ACK flush.
IDLE flush produces no completion; reset cancels flush/control without reply.
Flush completes <=256 clocks after accepted host responses drain regardless of pause/completion backpressure.
Shared array sustains legal input frame II1 with ready consumer and no pause/flush.
Publish per-mode latency; hold output and identity through backpressure.
Align bypass/tail data, roots, valid and metadata.
Service bank conflicts in legal rounds and gather every word into its correct operand slot.
Budget FFT root1/cycle, prefetch complete lane roots, clear cache valid at each CMD/flush.
Pack small independent NTT jobs with per-job index/root schedule and active masks.
Use specified NTT bundle order/bank mapping, broadcast or serialize conflicts, no padded-row request.
Preserve limb fusion grouping/sign/shift and retained-width exact product.
Keep FFT half-operands/cross products and NTT A/sum/root/tail side paths until consumed.
Provide implementation manifest covering all items in03.9 and interface mapping.
Use two independently owned microbatch contexts; no reuse until all effects commit.
Collect p0/p1/p2 by logical lane; never combine incomplete or mismatched triplets.
Maintain command tag, job, stage, lane, destination and epoch ownership through retire.
Detect duplicate/unknown current-epoch phase errors; discard canceled-epoch packets without new-command writes.
READY requires all coefficients/roots and output capacity for active lanes.
Inactive lanes are explicitly masked/zero and have no side effect.
Memory-pass barrier waits for committed writes; paired NTT layers fuse inside one pass; resolve in-place RAW/WAW hazards.
Epoch increments on CMD/cancel; modulo wrap never replaces drain; reset clears every pipeline valid.
Map every mandatory requirement to recorded test results or explicitly reviewed waiver; NOT_RUN is not PASS.
Check coefficient-independent schedule with identical config/initial state/flow trace.
Publish completion <=1048576 active clocks for a valid unflushed/unreset command.
Release source/tool/seed/hash/coverage/assertion/provenance/performance/deviation manifest.
